commanders.name: Marcel de Brie
commanders.title: The Quartermaster
commanders.strategy_summary: High card value weight (0.84), narrow gamble band (0.85). Careful reserve management pays off.

commanders.name: Bastien de Herve
commanders.title: The Attritionist
commanders.strategy_summary: Heavy deck sustainability penalty (-36). Grinds human players into late-game exhaustion.

commanders.name: Matthias von Greyerz
commanders.title: The Analyst
commanders.strategy_summary: High win-rate weight (56) and pool strength (0.16). Highly predictable; exploited by human players.

commanders.name: Sir Edmund Gloucester
commanders.title: The Gambler
commanders.strategy_summary: Broadest gamble band (1.35) and zero depletion penalty. High variance, near-even results.

commanders.name: Lorenzo di Taleggio
commanders.title: The Cornered General
commanders.strategy_summary: Severe desperation bonus (58 at <= 3 cards). Counter-attacks with lethal intensity.
